response.sql: WITH album_averages AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM album_averages) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond - o.bytes_per_millisecond AS difference_above_average FROM album_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE a.average_bytes_per_millisecond IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
